title: Stop wavering where mercy already holds you
summary: This meets the body leaning toward the worst outcome. The line answers wavering with the Creator's mercy and protection.
lifeApplication: When fear starts arranging tomorrow, feel both feet on the floor and unclench the stomach. Let mercy speak before another imagined disaster does.

source.shortMeaning: Mercy steadies the mind before the danger has changed.
source.lifeApplication: When you start wavering, let mercy speak before the disaster story grows.

evidence.coreClaim: Mercy steadies the mind before the danger has changed.
evidence.turn: The Creator's mercy is steadier than your wavering.
evidence.practicalImplication: When fear starts arranging tomorrow, feel both feet on the floor and unclench the stomach. Let mercy speak before another imagined disaster does.
